question: Reduce cumulative NOL comparison tokens without dropping exact room/rate evidence or weakening the completion contract.

sources.finding: Clear retrievable tool results while retaining persistent notes. Aggressive clearing can cause rereads and invalidates cached prefixes; measure cache creation, turns, and verified completion as well as tokens.

Observation masking was competitive with LLM summarization in SWE-agent/SWE-bench Verified. Window tuning did not transfer automatically to OpenHands. Workshop research; no measured NOL/browser transfer or promised reduction percentage.
Use bounded ranges, filtering and pagination with explicit recovery instructions. Preserve identifiers needed for subsequent calls and inspect redundant calls and errors.
Playwright discourages using networkidle to assert readiness; use observable page conditions. wait_for_function can await a DOM predicate.

measured_baseline.stop: The next prompt exceeds the estimated remaining token budget.
measured_baseline.observations: Repeated 300-line captures and subsequent range reads occurred before recording, including late-page room modals. Each evidence response carried the full source inventory and guidance. Execution prompt inputs grew from 16855 to a peak of 57923 tokens.

decision_memory: Keep full source text, hashes, timestamps, ownership, fixed query and exact numbered citations unchanged.

Default capture previews the header and trailing detail regions, with explicit omitted-line count and saved-source read/find recovery. Preview is not a semantic policy extractor or proof of completeness.
Return compact candidate progress during collection; full query/source inventory remains available through status and in trusted runtime metadata.

Remove superseded inventories from model history while retaining all unrecorded source excerpts. Retire earlier UI after recording or corresponding capture only when a newer UI observation preserves current controls. Keep failed actions visible.

Validate a short user request without fixture URLs, hotel IDs, tool names, JSON schema or procedural instructions. Keep the existing independent exact-citation and completion checks and standard $5/1.5M-token cap.
After a successful capture, remove the current read-only observation body from model history while preserving every control ref and link verbatim. Stored exact text remains available via read/find.

A second short trial exhausted the $5 cost budget after six tool errors. Supply canonical public NOL home/overseas-search entrypoints at begin, using the fixed query and no property IDs. This is a site adapter, not fixture selection.

Return capture-specific structural guidance: an overseas property overview cannot supply room-rate evidence; the room-list view can be cited if it actually contains the requested conditions. Preserve the existing rejection rules.

Entry route provenance: real browser navigate tool call 3 and screenshots in the first short trial confirmed the public discovery/list/search route with q, verticalCategory, checkInDate/checkOutDate, adultCount and roomCount. A web-fetch verification attempt could not access this dynamic page; do not mistake that for browser failure or infer route support for every locale.

Two trials with entrypoint/source guidance produced one pass and one cost-budget stop. Successful property work still accumulated assistant/tool exchanges after its facts were recorded. A completed-property checkpoint now replaces whole successful exchange pairs with trusted ledger progress.

Checkpointing is enabled only by the single browser-read runtime state. Preserve all user/system messages, the current run begin boundary, discovery links, incomplete-property sources, nonbrowser/mixed batches, failures and current controls. Keep source IDs/full query and missing fields for recovery. A checkpoint does not finalize the task; finish and exact-citation checks remain required.
Defer the 9,463-character browser_batch schema on initially read-only browser tasks; it remains discoverable/callable. Write tasks retain their original catalog.

Pass-through telemetry confirms the property checkpoint runs: context dropped from 83,071 to 55,441 chars (6 messages) and 99,630 to 65,828 chars (20 messages) at completed-property boundaries. It does not modify the returned runtime context.

A saved 217-character Grand Hotel room-list source was still a loading placeholder. Fresh visible Chromium probe returned HTTP 200, 217 body chars at 2.29/4.30 seconds, then 13,162 chars at 6.30 seconds. Observed animate-pulse skeleton elements numbered 68 before data and zero after. Before capture, wait at most 12 seconds for visible placeholders to disappear; timeout stores no source. A hidden placeholder or sold-out text is not itself blocked. No networkidle, fixed sleep or language-specific loading detection in production.

Offer a room_list_url derived from the captured NOL property URL, preserving its property/date/guest query and dropping modal fragments. The public sibling /list route was exercised in real runs. This avoids confusing property-information modals with room selection. No fixed hotel IDs or rate data are injected.

research_harness.limitations: The audit read the paper's main results/discussion/limitations and tools article; its cookbook fetch elided middle sections. Root separately read the tool-clearing cache-invalidation and reread warnings. No external source demonstrates NOL success.

Exact evidence completion is not complete semantic validation or booking.
